body: Greg, 2026-11-11 ~09:11Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1370): 'Bo termal na dl560 uruchamiany jest z sesji ssh z central...'. The DL560 TermAl host runs inside an SSH session opened from Central. CONSEQUENCE: any Central reboot or SSH drop ends the DL560 host and every run on it: FULLs, author runs, runner sessions. Seen on 2026-11-11, when the Windows-initiated Central reboot at ~08:30Z killed combo51's FULL and the DL560 author runs; the DL560 link came back authenticated at 09:05:48Z after Greg restarted it. A DL560 run that dies with the host is classified ENVIRONMENT, not a gate failure. Relaunch the same input with a confirmed start; that is not a retry-to-green. Running the DL560 host detached from Central's SSH session (tmux/systemd) is Greg's configuration decision, not an agent's.
